observations: WP-12ch / WP-S2c-40 is the H-006 combined R1+R2 cycle 1 evidence package. It uses existing committed EXP-0006 and creates REP-0024, one trial-log row, OL-0024, and two separate RECs from OL-0024 for d2_006_gates and exp_success_criteria. The bounded run liquidated on 2025-05-24 12:29:59.999000+00:00, produced negative OOS Sharpe, failed 7 of 8 D2-006 gates, and preserved gross-PnL-negative cost-drag as undefined/misleading rather than healthy cost behavior. The selected exact segments are H-006 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / d2_006_gates and H-006 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria.
The evaluation window is explicit and non-cloned: 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, with 17520 30m bars from 2025-04-12 00:29:59.999000+00:00 through 2026-04-11 23:59:59.999000+00:00.
